name: GoodAccess
summary: GoodAccess is a cloud-managed business VPN with a 14-day trial and prices from $7 per user a month on annual billing, with a five-user minimum. A dedicated gateway with a static IP address costs $49 a month on top. Admins invite users by hand or provision them from an identity provider.

facts.text: A dedicated gateway with a static IP costs $49 a month, and extra gateways for high availability cost $49 a month each.
Essential and Premium need at least 5 users, and Enterprise needs at least 50.
Members can be invited by hand or provisioned from an identity provider with SSO and SCIM.
GoodAccess shows SOC 2 compliant and ISO 27001 certified badges on its site.
Annual plans can be upgraded at any time, but downgrades only take effect at renewal.

plans.name: Essential (annual billing)
plans.notes: Billed annually. Minimum 5 users. Monthly billing costs $9 per user.

plans.name: Premium (annual billing)
plans.notes: Billed annually. Minimum 5 users. Monthly billing costs $14 per user. One cloud or branch connector is included.

hiddenCosts: A dedicated gateway with static IP costs $49 a month per gateway.
Additional cloud and branch connectors cost $29 a month.
Wire transfer payment is annual-only, and crypto is not accepted.
